summary: Elbit Systems filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 18, 2026 press release announcing that it has filed a shelf prospectus with the Israel Securities Authority and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, effective two years. The shelf permits discretionary offerings of debt and equity in Israel, each via a supplemental shelf offering report; no scope, terms, or timing decision has been made, and no certainty any offering occurs. Securities are not registered under the US Securities Act and will be sold only in Israel absent registration or exemption. This is a routine shelf registration, not a special situation; watch for any supplemental offering report, which would convert it into a capital-raising event.
